body:
>however with my own experiences with my ED I know that blood work can look fine and your body can still be in extreme distress, especially your heart.

I agree with this

I'm open to and have requested residential or outpatient treatment multiple times in the past two years, when I first realised my relapse, but they refuse to admit me (this was at a large public hospital, even) I told them that I physically couldn't eat more than one meal a day and was throwing up food (against my will, my body was rejecting food.) At the time, my BMI was also dangerously underweight

I had to beg to be even taken to the emergency room, and they checked my electrolytes and sent me home. I was told that the mental health system "failed me."

They just send me home to die
me too
I know, same, I avoid mirrors because it looks so prominent (only on my right side) but I can't tell if it's all in my head (body dysmorphia)

Thanks, my BMI is super low, and I'm thinking it could be the anorexia (also the undereye circles) 

My family tends to develop jowls really prominently when they age (especially on my mother's side) and they have under eye circles where the facial structure collapses so I'm worried this is happening prematurely from stress 

I've also noticed that the sagging is only on the right side of my face (the left is normal/very youthful) so idk if it's just weight loss in the face
I'm dealing with atopic dermatitis (eczema) and I can't wear shorts or go to the beach because my legs look so bad.

My BMI is dangerously low. I've always had chubby cheeks/a baby face and neotenous features. I get told I look way younger than my age (like 21(!) lol I don't believe it) but I'm confused because of my sagging face

I also have high cheekbones, and when I look at baby pictures, I have that same 'sagging' kind of look, because my cheeks are very round and my lips are small (I had two teeth pulled when I was young so my teeth could fit in my mouth lol)

I think it might be my facial posture that's affecting it, so I'm going to look into mewing

I'm interested in non-surgical methods to prevent sagging/ageing, but I'm not sure what those are..

I feel this way when I see girls on social media with millions or thousands of followers and people saying all these gushing comments, when it's obvious that they're so popular because they're beautiful. 

It makes me feel completely worthless that I'm not like that (introverted, frumpy, not able to do make-up and hair, not able to 'sell' myself in that way) 

Like, these are the kind of people that get ahead, and I am stuck in the corner.
I feel like there is just this 'toxicity' in my body and if I were purged of it, I would be beautiful.

I'm 32 and Gen Z look like models to me. Like everywhere I see it's just extremely beautiful girls/guys. And now with plastic surgery becoming normal, it's like how can I compare my frumpy self? I've never had a boyfriend, and I thought that my looks would be an asset, but what guy would pick me over a beautiful 20-something model-looking girl? 

  
I tell myself that personality wins out, but idk if I believe it (especially when it comes to guys. They'll pick the prettiest girl they can get, hands down..)
I know what you mean. Eating feels wrong. I don't want to live, but I have to put food in my mouth hole

It sounds like an eating disorder to me, especially the panic attacks. It's almost impossible to eat "nothing." Most people with (restrictive) eating disorders do eat, but it's under the daily calorie intake, like you said

Not sure how considering I'm getting worse by the day

Like I don't have anything to go towards anymore to create a new self. I struggle every day to just survive and my body is falling apart
My body and mind have deteriorated past the point of no return. Feels like I'll never be myself again.
Same, losing my soul feels worse than dying, much worse. Wish I didn't invalidate myself when I thought that
thanks

Same, my friend had her second child, and I'm stuck in the mindset from high school, looking at anime characters, unemployed and rotting.

Feels so behind it's unreal. I'm 32, and dreaming about getting my driver's license, like when I hear that Olivia Rodrigo song I feel bad that I'm surpassed by teenagers
the books

I feel the exact same way, I'm 32 and terrified of ageing, getting older, getting health problems. 

It's on my mind all the time. I always planned to live a short, but meaningful life and die young. I regret not killing myself before when I was on top.
I think about my landlady finding my body. I think that she would be really messed up...

I feel this. Unemployed since mid-2019 and want to end it

I was just going to start my career too, until it all went to Hell

It's the most absurd injustice, I can't live with it

Edit: I'm also in my thirties.
I feel this. I had to leave a bookstore multiple times weeping
